findings.snippet: response media type is application/xml — GDS mandates JSON (application/json or a +json subtype)
'basicAuth' is HTTP basic authentication, which NCSC advises against; use OAuth 2.0 or OpenID Connect instead
GET /users switches authentication off with security: []

good_examples.GDS-004:
responses:
  '200':
    description: OK
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'
good_examples.NCSC-001:
components:
  securitySchemes:
    departmentOAuth:
      type: oauth2
      flows:
        clientCredentials:
          tokenUrl: https://auth.example.gov.uk/token
          scopes: {}
good_examples.NCSC-002:
security:
  - departmentOAuth: []
paths:
  /v1/users:
    get:
      # No operation-level `security` — inherits the root requirement.
      responses:
        '200': {...}
good_examples.REC-002:
paths:
  /v1/users:
    get:
      summary: List users
      description: |
        Returns a paginated list of users visible to the caller.
        Filterable by department and status.
